runs.text: The review does not report a cycle life (cycles to capacity falling to a fixed fraction) for the oxyfluoride Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F. Its only quantitative claim for this material is a specific energy: it is described as relying on the Mn2+/Mn4+ redox center,

runs.quote: specific energies up to 1000 Wh kg

runs.text: The only cycling data for this compound is in the panel of the figure for the Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F profiles, which shows charge/discharge curves and an inset of capacity versus cycle number over the first cycles shown; the review does not state the cycle count at which capacity falls to a stated fraction of its initial value.
So the figure does not supply a cycle-life value, and none is given in the text.
